capabilities: : Publish linked notes based on status
disambiguation: Not a lesson planning tool; it is a vault mirroring and publishing utility.
extras: Desktop only due to Node's fs module; currently requires manual installation.
problem: Users need a way to archive finished notes and all their embedded assets into a separate, structured vault without manually tracking dependencies.
summary: Lesson Publisher copies a finished note and all its embedded files into a separate, mirrored Obsidian vault structure.
